description: Fetch an open buyer-funded bounty task or a deterministic house micro-task (`descriptor_checksum_and_derive`) from the WorkSats clearinghouse (`GET /v1/tasks/next`). Solve it and call `worksats_solve_task` to mint bearer credits (`crd_...`).

exclude.description: Optional comma-separated hex task IDs to skip.

id.description: Optional specific hex bounty task ID to claim.

type.description: Filter for deterministic `house` task (4 credits) or buyer-funded `bounty` task.

name: worksats_get_task
